flags.sourceSentence: At the end of the initial term, and at the end of each term thereafter, your membership renews automatically for a further twelve (12) month term at the then-current rate.
flags.consequence: Missing the 3-day cancellation window renews the membership for another full 12-month term without a fresh signature, at a rate the member does not control.

flags.sourceSentence: Notice delivered after that day takes effect at the end of the term that follows, and the dues for the intervening term remain payable in full.
flags.consequence: Missing the 3-day cancellation window commits the member to a full additional 12-month term at the then-current rate, which could be higher, and dues for that whole term remain payable even if they stop using the club. A suspended, frozen or medically held membership also keeps renewing on the original schedule, so dues can accrue during a period the member cannot attend.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may amend the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, the hours of operation, the class timetable and the terms of this Agreement at any time by posting the amended version at the club or on the Meridian website, and the amended version applies to you from the date it is posted.
flags.consequence: Meridian can change the fees, the rules, the hours, the timetable and the terms of this agreement itself at any time, and the changes apply from the date of posting, with the member's continued use treated as acceptance — so the member can become bound to new terms, including higher charges, without agreeing to them.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian’s total liability to you for any claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or your use of any facility — whether the claim is framed in contract, in negligence or otherwise — will not exceed the total dues and fees you paid to Meridian in the twelve (12) months immediately before the event giving rise to the claim.
flags.consequence: The member's total recovery from Meridian for any claim — including negligence — is capped at the dues and fees paid in the prior 12 months, and Meridian owes nothing for lost income, lost business opportunity, or property lost or damaged on the premises, including property left in a locker.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify, defend and hold harmless Meridian and its ofﬁcers, employees, instructors and contractors against any claim, demand, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable legal fees, that is brought by a third party and arises out of your use of the facilities, your conduct on club premises, the conduct of a guest you bring, or any service you provide to another member.
flags.consequence: The member must pay Meridian's legal costs and any third-party claim arising from their use of the facilities, their conduct, a guest's conduct, or any service they provide to another member, and cannot settle the claim without Meridian's written consent, with Meridian choosing the lawyer.

flags.sourceSentence: For twelve (12) months after your Program candidacy ends for any reason, you will not teach, coach or deliver group ﬁtness instruction or personal training, whether as an employee, as a contractor or on your own account, at any facility within ﬁfteen (15) miles of a Meridian location at which you taught or trained.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after their Program candidacy ends for any reason — including if Meridian ends it or the member cannot afford tuition — the member cannot teach, coach or deliver fitness or personal training, in any capacity, within 15 miles of any Meridian location where they taught or trained, and cannot solicit Meridian members or candidates for outside instruction.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute, claim or controversy between you and Meridian arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or the Program will be resolved by ﬁnal and binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer arbitration rules, and you and Meridian each waive any right to a trial by jury and any right to bring or participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The member gives up the right to a jury trial and to bring or join a class, collective or representative action, and must resolve any dispute — including serious ones — in individual binding arbitration where the award is final.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may adjust dues once in any twelve (12) month period by the greater of six percent (6%)  or the increase in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers over the preceding twelve months, on thirty (30) days notice to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: Meridian can raise dues once every 12 months by the greater of 6% or CPI on 30 days' email notice, so the member's cost could rise by at least 6% annually regardless of what they originally agreed to pay.

flags.sourceSentence: Dues not received within ten (10) days of the draw date incur the late charge set out in the Schedule of Fees then in effect, which is posted at the Member Services desk and on the Meridian website and forms part of this Agreement.
flags.consequence: Late payments incur a charge whose amount is not stated in this document — it is set in a separate Schedule of Fees posted at the desk and online, which the member may not have seen, and similar open-ended charges apply for returned payments, keycard replacement and account reinstatement.

flags.sourceSentence: You authorise Meridian to draw all dues, tuition and charges from the payment method on your account until this Agreement has ended and your balance is nil.
flags.consequence: The member authorises an open-ended automatic draw of all dues, tuition and charges from their payment method until the agreement ends and the balance is nil, so any disputed or erroneous charge is still taken from their account first.

flags.sourceSentence: Candidates are expected to complete sixty (60) supervised teaching hours in each Program year, and a candidate who falls short may be held back a year at Meridian’s discretion.
flags.consequence: A candidate who completes fewer than 60 supervised teaching hours in a Program year can be held back a year at Meridian's sole discretion, extending the time and tuition needed to finish the Program.

flags.sourceSentence: Program enrolment renews on each anniversary of your Program start date at the then-current tuition.
flags.consequence: Program enrolment renews automatically each year at the then-current tuition — which could be higher — unless the member gives written notice at least 90 days before the anniversary date, and missing that window commits them to another full year of tuition.

flags.sourceSentence: Access is by keycard or through the application, and you are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or your account.
flags.consequence: The member is responsible for every entry made with their keycard or account, so if the card or account credentials are lost, stolen or misused, the member bears the cost or consequences of any unauthorised access.

flags.sourceSentence: You agree to keep the contact details, billing details and emergency contact on your account current, and to tell Member Services in writing of any change within ten (10) days.
flags.consequence: The member must keep account contact, billing and emergency contact details current and report any change in writing within 10 days, or they are in breach of the agreement.

flags.sourceSentence: You will return the coaching manual and any Meridian teaching materials in your possession within fourteen (14) days of the end of your candidacy.
flags.consequence: The member must return the coaching manual and all Meridian teaching materials within 14 days of their candidacy ending, regardless of why it ended.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Plot Holder gives notice, no refund is due, and the Plot Holder may harvest whatever is ready before the notice period runs out.
flags.consequence: If the Plot Holder ends the licence early, they lose the unused portion of the $45 season fee; the Association keeps it even though the Plot Holder stops using the plot, and may harvest only what is ready before the thirty days run out.

flags.sourceSentence: Anything left after 15 December becomes the Association’s to keep or to clear.
flags.consequence: Any of the Plot Holder's belongings left on the plot after 15 December 2027 — canes, netting, frames or other items — is permanently lost to the Association, which may keep or dispose of it.

flags.sourceSentence: We may revise the fee for any plan, and a revised fee applies to you from the start of the first Billing Period that begins more than thirty (30) days after we send notice of the revision to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: The company can raise the signer's fee at any time, and the new amount automatically applies from the first Billing Period starting more than 30 days after an email notice — the signer's only way to avoid it is to cancel.

flags.sourceSentence: On an annual plan the deadline to cancel is the day that falls thirty (30) days before the anniversary of the date you first subscribed, and where no cancellation is received by that day the term extends by a further twelve (12) months at the annual fee then in effect.
flags.consequence: On an annual plan, missing the cancellation deadline commits the signer to a further twelve months of charges at whatever the annual fee is at that time, with no fresh signature.

flags.sourceSentence: We may amend these terms, the pricing page and the Fee Schedule at any time, an amended version takes effect when we post it at northwindstudio.example/terms, and your continued use of the service after it is posted is your acceptance of the amended version.
flags.consequence: The company can rewrite these terms, the pricing page and the Fee Schedule at any time, and the new version binds the signer simply because they kept using the service after it was posted — including terms the signer has never been individually notified of.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Northwind harmless from any claim brought by a third party that relates to content you uploaded, exported or published through the service, including a claim that the content infringes a copyright, a trade mark or a right of privacy, and you will pay our reasonable legal costs of defending such a claim.
flags.consequence: The signer must pay Northwind's reasonable legal costs and cover any third-party claim connected to content they uploaded, exported or published — an obligation that is open-ended and not capped by the liability limit in Section 5.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between you and Northwind arising out of these terms or out of your use of the service will be settled by binding arbitration before a single arbitrator under the consumer rules of a recognised arbitration body, and you agree to bring any claim only in your individual capacity and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective or representative proceeding.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up court and jury trials and any class action for disputes with Northwind; claims must go through individual binding arbitration with a final award, leaving only small claims court for qualifying individual claims.

flags.sourceSentence: Where a payment is not collected on its due date, interest accrues on the unpaid amount at one and one half percent (1.5%) per month from the due date until payment is received, and an account suspended for non-payment is subject to the reactivation charge published in the Fee Schedule on the Northwind support site.
flags.consequence: A missed or failed payment accrues interest at 1.5% per month (18% a year) until paid, and reactivating a suspended account costs an unspecified charge set in a Fee Schedule the signer has not seen.

flags.sourceSentence: Your subscription continues from one Billing Period into the next without further action by either of us, and we bill the plan fee then in effect on the first day of each new Billing Period.
flags.consequence: The agreement continues into each new Billing Period without any fresh action, and the signer is billed the then-current fee on the first day of each period; a cancellation made even one day into a period still costs that full period's fee with no refund.

flags.sourceSentence: Where availability in a calendar month falls below that figure, your remedy is the service credit set out in the Service Credit Policy and nothing further.
flags.consequence: If the service is down below 99.5% in a month, the signer's only remedy is a service credit defined in a policy published elsewhere that the signer has not been given, with no other compensation even for significant losses.

flags.sourceSentence: Northwind’s aggregate liability to you for every claim relating to the service, whether framed in contract, in tort, in warranty or otherwise — and including any claim arising from lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — will not exceed the amount you actually paid us under Section 2 for the Billing Period in which the claim arose.
flags.consequence: If the service loses the signer's work, revenue, or an export fails, the most the signer can recover is the fee paid for the single Billing Period in which the problem occurred — potentially far less than the actual loss.

flags.sourceSentence: You may not share your credentials with anyone else, and an account we believe is being used by more than one person may be suspended while we ask you about it.
flags.consequence: The account can be suspended while Northwind investigates, based only on its own belief that more than one person is using it — interrupting the signer's access and any work stored there without a stated process.

flags.sourceSentence: We may list your organisation’s name in the customer list on our website, and we will remove it within ten working days of your asking us to.
flags.consequence: Northwind can publicly list the signer's organisation as a customer unless the signer asks for removal, and removal takes up to ten working days.

flags.sourceSentence: Ardent may introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, handbook provision, benefit plan or term of employment described in this letter at any time and without your agreement, and the version in force on the Ardent intranet governs from the date it is published there.
flags.consequence: Ardent can introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, benefit plan or term of employment described in the letter at any time without the signer's agreement, with the change taking effect simply by being published on the company intranet — meaning pay-related terms, benefits and working conditions could change unilaterally.

flags.sourceSentence: For a period of twelve (12) months following the last day of your employment, whether that employment ends at your choice or at ours, you will not provide services that are the same as or substantially similar to those you provided to Ardent, whether as an employee, a consultant, a contractor, an adviser or a principal, to any business that develops, manufactures or sells a product within the Restricted Field as that term is defined in Exhibit B to this letter.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after employment ends — even if Ardent ends it — the signer cannot work in a similar capacity for any business in the 'Restricted Field' defined in Exhibit B, and cannot solicit Ardent employees or approach Ardent customers, distributors or contract manufacturers they dealt with, which could block their main employment options in their field.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify Ardent and hold it harmless against any claim, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable attorney fees, that arises out of a breach by you of Section 4 or Section 5 of this letter, or out of a claim by a former employer that your employment with Ardent breaches an obligation you owe to them.
flags.consequence: The signer must personally pay Ardent's claims, losses, liabilities and expenses including attorney fees if they breach the confidentiality or post-termination sections, or if a former employer claims the new job breaches an obligation owed to it — an open-ended amount the signer would owe on top of any defense costs.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Ardent each agree that any claim arising out of or relating to your employment, its terms, or its end, including any statutory claim, will be resolved by final and binding arbitration administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised arbitration provider, on an individual basis only, and each of us waives any right to a jury trial and any right to participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and to participate in class, collective or representative actions, and must bring any employment-related claim — including statutory claims — as an individual in final and binding arbitration, changing how they could contest a serious dispute such as wrongful termination or unpaid wages.

flags.sourceSentence: If you resign or are terminated for cause within twelve (12) months of your start date, the full signing payment becomes repayable within thirty days of your last working day.
flags.consequence: If the signer resigns or is fired for cause within 12 months of the 4 May 2026 start date, the entire $15,000 signing payment must be repaid within 30 days of the last working day — even for a partial year of service.

flags.sourceSentence: Bonus awards are discretionary in amount and in whether they are made at all, and an award is paid only if you are employed on the payment date.
flags.consequence: The discretionary bonus is not guaranteed: Ardent decides both whether to pay and how much, and no bonus is paid if the signer is not employed on the payment date, so a year of work could end with no bonus if employment ends just before payment.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant will indemnify, defend and hold the Operator harmless from every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense, including reasonable attorney fees, brought by any person and arising out of the Occupant's use of the unit or the premises, the property stored in the unit, or the acts of anyone the Occupant allows on to the premises.
flags.consequence: The occupant must pay for and defend against every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense — including attorney fees — brought by anyone arising from the occupant's use of the unit or premises, the stored property, or the acts of anyone the occupant lets onto the premises, with no dollar cap stated.

flags.sourceSentence: Gate hours, the rules posted in the office, and the terms of this Agreement may be changed by the Operator on notice posted at the facility and sent to the Occupant's last known email address, and the changed version applies to the Occupant from the first day of the month after it is posted.
flags.consequence: The Operator can change the gate hours, the posted rules, and the terms of this agreement itself — including any term — by posting a notice at the facility and emailing the occupant's last known address, with the changes binding from the first day of the following month; no cap on changes and no right to leave without penalty is stated in the clause.

flags.sourceSentence: Where rent or any charge is unpaid, the Operator has a lien on all property stored in the unit and may deny the Occupant access, overlock the unit, and after the notice period the law requires, sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed.
flags.consequence: If rent or any charge goes unpaid, the Operator holds a lien on everything in the unit, can block the occupant's access and overlock the unit, and after the legally required notice period can sell the contents and keep the proceeds to cover what is owed — so the occupant could lose access to, and then ownership of, all stored property over a payment dispute.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may increase the monthly rent on not less than thirty (30) days written notice to the Occupant, and the increased rent is due on the first rent day falling after the notice period ends.
flags.consequence: The Operator can raise the monthly rent on 30 days' written notice, and the occupant's only way to avoid the higher rent is to end the agreement and move out.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent not received by the sixth day of the month incurs the late charge shown in the Schedule of Charges posted in the ofﬁce and on the Harbour Road website, and each further notice the Operator is required to send about an unpaid balance incurs the administration charge shown in the same schedule.
flags.consequence: Late and administration charges are set in a Schedule of Charges posted in the office and on a website rather than in this agreement, so the occupant cannot see from this document how much a late payment or each notice about an unpaid balance will cost, and the per-notice charge can repeat with each collection notice.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator's total liability to the Occupant for any loss of or damage to stored property, however caused, including loss or damage caused by the Operator's own negligence, is limited to five thousand dollars ($5,000) unless the Occupant has declared a higher value on the Unit Schedule and paid the corresponding value protection fee.
flags.consequence: The occupant must carry insurance on everything stored, at full value, and produce proof on request; without it, the occupant bears all risk of loss. Even with it, the Operator's liability for loss or damage to stored property — including damage the Operator's own negligence causes — is capped at $5,000 unless the occupant declared a higher value on the Unit Schedule and paid a value protection fee.

flags.sourceSentence: After the initial term this Agreement continues on a month to month basis, each month renewing on the first day of the month without notice from either party, until it is ended as Section 8 describes.
flags.consequence: The agreement does not end on its own: after the first month it continues month to month indefinitely, so the occupant must actively give written notice at least ten days before the end of a month to stop owing rent.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent already paid for the month in which the Occupant moves out is not refunded.
flags.consequence: If the occupant moves out during a month, the rent already paid for that month is kept by the Operator even though the occupant no longer has the unit for the rest of it.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a twelve month promotional plan renews for a further twelve month term at the end of the term then running, at the standard rate for the plan rather than at the promotional rate, unless you tell us to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term.
flags.consequence: A twelve-month promotional plan renews automatically for another twelve-month term at the standard rate rather than the promotional rate, so missing the notice deadline commits the signer to a full year at a higher, unstated rate.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade may change any term of this Agreement, any charge, and any feature of your rate plan, and the change takes effect on the date stated in the notice we give you, which may be given on a bill, by message to your device, or by email.
flags.consequence: Cascade can unilaterally change any term of the agreement, any charge, and any feature of the rate plan, with the change taking effect on a date stated in a notice sent by bill, device message or email, and continued use counts as accepting it. The only stated limit is a 30-day penalty-free cancellation window for changes that materially increase the monthly recurring charge; changes to other terms, one-time charges or features carry no stated exit right.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Cascade agree that any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, the service or any device will be resolved by individual binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer rules, and both of us give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action, so serious disputes must be pursued as individual binding arbitration; this can be avoided only by written rejection within 30 days of activating service.

flags.sourceSentence: An amount not paid by the due date shown on the bill incurs a late payment charge of the greater of five dollars ($5.00) or one and one half percent of the unpaid balance, applied each bill period until the balance is paid, and a restored line incurs the restoral charge shown in the Rate and Charge Guide.
flags.consequence: An unpaid balance incurs a late charge of the greater of $5.00 or 1.5% of the unpaid balance, applied again every bill period until the balance is paid, so the charge compounds and grows over time.

flags.sourceSentence: Cancelling a promotional plan before the end of its term does not cancel a device instalment plan, and the unpaid instalment balance becomes due in full on your next bill.
flags.consequence: Cancelling a promotional plan before the end of its term makes the entire unpaid device instalment balance due in full on the next bill, a lump sum of an amount set in the instalment plan the signer has not supplied.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade’s entire liability to you for any claim relating to the service, a device, or this Agreement, whether the claim is made in contract, in negligence, in warranty or under any statute, is limited to the service charges applied to the affected line during the bill period in which the claim arose, and Cascade is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or any indirect or consequential loss.
flags.consequence: Cascade's total liability for any claim is capped at one bill period's service charges for the affected line, and it is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or indirect or consequential loss, so a serious service or device failure could leave the signer with recovery far below actual losses.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Cascade harmless from any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal fees, arising out of your use of the service, out of anything sent from or stored on your device, out of the use of your line by anyone you allow to use it, and out of any charge incurred on your account.
flags.consequence: The signer must cover Cascade's claims, losses and expenses, including legal fees, arising from use of the service, anything sent from or stored on the device, use of the line by anyone the signer allows, and any charge incurred on the account — an open-ended obligation with no cap.

flags.sourceSentence: Charges accrue to the end of the bill period in which you cancel, and a part bill period is not prorated.
flags.consequence: When the signer cancels, charges accrue to the end of the bill period and the partial period is not prorated, so the signer pays for days of service they will not use after cancelling.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may end the Programme early for any reason on one week written notice.
flags.consequence: The Firm can end the twelve-week Programme early for any reason on one week's written notice, cutting off the remaining stipend weeks the Analyst may have planned around.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may amend the Programme Handbook, the assessment structure, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement at any time by issuing a revised version to the Analyst by email, and the revised version applies from the date of that email.
flags.consequence: The Firm can unilaterally change the Handbook, the assessments, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement itself at any time, with each change taking effect simply by emailing it — no cap on changes, no advance notice period, and no right for the Analyst to leave without penalty is stated.

flags.sourceSentence: For six (6) months after the Programme ends, the Analyst will not accept an engagement, whether paid or unpaid and whether as an employee, a contractor or an intern, with any firm on the Restricted List issued to the Analyst in week one of the Programme, and will not approach any client of the Firm whose file the Analyst worked on.
flags.consequence: For six months after the Programme ends, the Analyst cannot take any engagement, paid or unpaid, with any firm on a confidential Restricted List that can be reissued and changed during the Programme, and cannot approach clients whose files they worked on — a broad restraint on future work with no compensation stated.

flags.sourceSentence: The Analyst will indemnify the Firm and hold it harmless against any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal costs, arising out of a breach by the Analyst of Section 4 or Section 5, or out of anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or a client of the Firm.
flags.consequence: The Analyst must pay the Firm's claims, losses, expenses and legal costs arising from any breach of the confidentiality or post-programme restrictions, or from anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or its clients — an open-ended amount with no cap.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between the Analyst and the Firm arising out of the Programme or out of this Agreement will be resolved by final and binding arbitration on an individual basis, administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised provider, and the Analyst gives up any right to a jury trial and any right to bring or join a class or collective action.
flags.consequence: The Analyst gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class or collective action, and must resolve any dispute individually in final and binding arbitration — removing court and group routes for contesting serious problems.

flags.sourceSentence: any instalment not recovered within ten (10) days of its due date carries the late charge set out in the Programme Handbook until it is repaid in full.
flags.consequence: A late charge of an unstated amount, set in the Programme Handbook, is added to each housing-advance instalment not recovered within ten days of its due date, and it keeps accruing until the advance is repaid in full.

flags.sourceSentence: An item not returned within five working days is charged at the replacement cost shown in the Programme Handbook.
flags.consequence: The Analyst is charged the replacement cost of any issued item — laptop, security token or building pass — not returned within five working days, with the amount set in the Programme Handbook where the Analyst cannot see it in this document.

flags.sourceSentence: A place given up later than that, and before the third lesson, is refunded at half the fee.
flags.consequence: If the signer gives up the place after the seven-day deadline but before the third lesson, half of the $120 fee ($60) is kept by the Centre.

flags.sourceSentence: After the third lesson no refund is made.
flags.consequence: If the signer gives up the place after the third lesson, the entire $120 fee is kept by the Centre, including for the remaining lessons the child will not attend.
